description: This file defines a PHP class 'CustomerSearch' which is a controller extension for the OpenCart admin panel. It handles CRUD operations, report generation, and listing for customer search data within the OpenCart platform.

classes.name: CustomerSearch
classes.description: Controller class for handling customer search reports and related operations in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the customer search report page, setting up breadcrumbs, loading language strings, and rendering the form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings, permissions, and returning success or error JSON responses.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Loads and displays the customer search report view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of customer search results in JSON format.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Processes request filters and fetches customer search data, returning it as a formatted string or JSON.
